services.name: ASU Summer Camp 2026
services.desc: Join Aikido Shobukan Dojo at our annual Summer Intensive, July 1-5, 2026! We’re incredibly honored to invite you to celebrate our 50th year as an active dojo with a five day intensive, with a rare focus on Saotome Sensei’s weapons kata. We have loaner weapons for those in need, but encourage folks to bring their own weapons if possible. 11:00 - 12:00 PM, Saotome Sensei12:00 -2:00 PM Lunch Break2:00 - 3:30 PM, Weapons 1 [Jo 1-6], Kamenna Lee3:45-5:15 PM, Weapons 2 [Jo 1-6], Stéphane Le Derf5:30 - 6:30 PM - Open Hand, Robert Deppe7pm Dojo Social Event 8:30 - 9:30 AM, Bokken 1-5 , Chris Royal10:00 - 11:00 AM, Open Hand, Brian Healy11:00 - 12:00 PM, Saotome Sensei12:00 - 2:00 PM Lunch Break2:00
